data.desc: Pluri is a biotechnology company leveraging its proprietary three-dimensional ('3D') cell expansion platform, which is supported by an in-house, industrial-scale cell manufacturing facility and operates in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practice ('GMP') standards on a self-declared basis. The platform is designed to enable scalable, cost-efficient and reproducible expansion of human, plant and animal cells and supports cell-based products, services, therapeutics and related technologies across Pluri's two principal business verticals: (i) Human Health & Longevity and (ii) Foodtech & Bio-Farming. Pluri also offers Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
